patch_description: Restructured into a seed-bank architecture with new geometric families (heptagonal antiprisms, cuboctahedron+poles with swept pole radii, fcc clusters, Fibonacci spirals, random and antipodal clouds), followed by a two-stage optimizer (Adam on a smoothed ratio, then SLSQP on the exact min-distance program) and a basin-hopping loop that perturbs and re-refines the incumbent. This escapes the single icosahedron+poles attractor that pinned the previous program at ratio 0.24, while keeping the same signature and output contract.
